exact: regulation of thrombin receptor signaling pathway
regulation of thrombin receptor signalling pathway

definition: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of a thrombin-activated receptor signaling pathway activity. A thrombin receptor signaling pathway is the series of molecular signals generated as a consequence of a thrombin-activated receptor binding to one of its physiological ligands.
label: regulation of thrombin-activated receptor signaling pathway
